subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors.
stimulus:   Facebook is a social medium (a) is very popular. (b) it provides the users with various information, all do  not use it for positive purposes. Many Facebook users (c) some of the youngsters sometimes use it   whimsically which creates (d) misunderstanding (e) destroys social peace and order.
guide_solution: (a) which; (b) Though/Although; (c) including; (d) not only; (e) but also.

subject: English
question_text: Complete the following passage using suitable connectors:
stimulus: Facebook is a social medium (a) ______ is very popular. (b) ______ it provides the users with various information, all do not use it for positive purposes. Many Facebook users (c) ______ some of the youngsters sometimes use it whimsically which creates (d) ______ misunderstanding (e) ______ destroys social peace and order.
guide_solution: (a) which (b) Although/Though (c) like/including (d) not only (e) but also
